paper.title: Disentangling Tensor Network States with Deep Neural Network
paper.authors: Chaohui Fan, Bo Zhan, Yuntian Gu, Tong Liu, Yantao Wu, Mingpu Qin, Dingshun Lv, Tao Xiang

results.system_description: 6x6 square lattice, periodic; J1 = 1, J2 = 0.5; S = sigma/2; total Sz = 0
results.variant: pure CNN, (h, l) = (32, 20), i.e. CNN-MPS with D = 1
results.source_location: main text, 6 x 6 paragraph (results section): 'we obtain an energy of -0.5037957(4)'
results.eligibility_evidence: Directly reported variational energy of the authors' own neural tensor network state (a neural network generating the tensors of a backflow MPS); not an extrapolation, a projector estimate or a quoted value.
results.notes: The same paragraph gives the exact energy -0.503810. Whether C4v symmetrization was used for this row is not stated. Spin-1/2 J1-J2 Heisenberg model on the L x L square lattice with periodic boundaries, J1 = 1 (main text). The Marshall sign transformation is applied. The Monte Carlo moves exchange opposite spins on nearest- and next-nearest-neighbour bonds, so the total S^z is conserved; the sector is not stated and S^z = 0 is inferred (the ground state is a singlet). Parameters are optimized with MARCH. The paper does not state the meaning of the parenthesized error, so it is recorded as unspecified.
